note: The crafts of the Quickwood/Palelands Reach (death_life axis). Vivimancy is the life-pole tradition, Palework the death-pole. Learned by traveling the Reach or training under Rootkin/Ashwardens — NOT available at Valley creation; gated like precursor (learned). Higher tiers pull the wielder's own pole-intensity toward their pole (a Vivimancer drifts life-hot, a Paleworker death-hot) — the geography writes itself onto the practitioner. axes use signed values for engine compat. Authored by Aevi (PO), SNG-016 skill build-out. | SNG-089 (Aevi 2026-07-12, Erik-directed): Ashwarden kit built out on D&D-proven necromancy — enfeeble (The Grey Hand), life-drain (Draw Down), fear (The Dread), speak-with-dead (Ask the Dead), and the LETHAL capstone THE CUT THREAD (the Fates' shears). And the notFor LAW applied: **a limit may constrain HOW an ability serves a need; it may NEVER forbid the need itself.** Palework's old clause ('does not force the living to die') contradicted its own FIGHT tag and made a necromancer unable to kill a boar. Now it constrains the METHOD: slow, visible, working through what is already in the thing.

_treeWas.name: Reading the Rot
_treeWas.grants: Read the physical evidence of death — what killed a ruin, what a plague did and will do next, what ended a thing and when. Halt a spreading rot by giving its front a clean end. AND TURN IT OUTWARD: against a living opponent, find the decline ALREADY in them — an infected wound, a sickness, exhaustion, an old injury — and hasten it. Their own ending is the weapon; you only bring it forward. It takes a few breaths, it is plainly visible, and they feel it starting.

_treeWas.name: Long Stillness
_treeWas.grants: Grant endings at scale — a battlefield eased, a plague stopped by stilling its front, a thing that should have died a century ago finally allowed to. AND THE FULL STRIKE: against a living opponent, take the ending every living thing carries and pull it forward whole. This kills. It is slow enough to be interrupted, bright enough to be witnessed, and the dying understand exactly what is being done and by whom. Ashwardens call it the mercy turned around, and they do not call it that kindly.
_treeWas.cannot: The wielder drifts death-hot; never raises, never forces a death that must not happen. It cannot smite a healthy thing dead where it stands from nothing — it works THROUGH what is in them, so it is slow and it is seen. For the instant, unseen ending, that is The Cut Thread, and it costs accordingly.

abilities.name: Kept Breath
